Warranty Information Product Demo The Long Story In just a few short years, Randy Rhoads revolutionized the art of the rock 'n' roll guitar player, merging fluid, classically inspired legato passages and melodies with searing, violin-like leads and super-saturated riffs. One of the most crucial components of this riveting sound was the MXR Distortion+—Randy harnessed its raw energy to slam his high-gain amplifier with a torrent of harmonics to create the sonic signature that would etch an indelible mark on music history. We celebrate his monumental legacy with this recreation of his own MXR Distortion+. For the first time in 42 years, the Rhoads family unveiled Randy’s pedalboard for the MXR design team at the family’s music school in Los Angeles—the Musonia School of Music. There, history was made as the MXR design team carefully opened the pedalboard, closely inspecting and documenting all they could from this rock ’n’ roll artifact. The engineers painstakingly spec'd Randy’s vintage Distortion+, with the direct involvement of sister Kathy Rhoads, and created this signature model to produce the same overdriven tones heard on Randy’s most beloved hits. Inspired by a supersonic airliner he flew on while on tour with Ozzy Osbourne, Randy designed a Flying V-style guitar with a white finish and a pinstripe accent. That iconic instrument is the inspiration for this special edition of the MXR Randy Rhoads Distortion+. Includes an exclusive collector's booklet. “We are very proud of and honored by this special signature pedal. It is a true tribute to Randy’s musical legacy.” —The Rhoads Family Feed Product Manual $189.99 USD --> Current Stock: Quantity: Decrease Quantity: Increase Quantity: Add to Bag atc-product: 2309 atc-product: 2194 atc-product: 1802 Related Gear Add to Bag MXR® 15 FT COIL GLOW INSTRUMENT CABLE - RIGHT / STRAIGHT DCICG15R $36.74 Decrease Quantity: Increase Quantity: MXR® RANDY RHOADS DISTORTION + RR104 Add to Bag MXR® WYLDE AUDIO OVERDRIVE WA44 $139.99 Decrease Quantity: Increase Quantity: Add to Bag MXR® 6 INCH RIBBON PATCH CABLE - 3 PACK 3PDCPR06 $26.24 Decrease Quantity: Increase Quantity: Choose Options MXR® MEN'S VINTAGE T-SHIRT DSD32MTS $20.99 Add to Bag MXR® MINI ISO-BRICK™ POWER SUPPLY M239 $105.99 Decrease Quantity: Increase Quantity: Add to Bag MXR® ISO-BRICK™ POWER SUPPLY M238 $179.99 Decrease Quantity: Increase Quantity: Choose Options MXR® FLEXI FIT CAP DSD2140 $29.39 Choose Options MXR® MEN'S T-SHIRT DSD21MTS $20.99 Add to Bag MXR® TRUCKER HAT DSD2142 $29.39 Decrease Quantity: Increase Quantity: Add to Bag MXR® DISTORTION+ M104 $99.99 Decrease Quantity: Increase Quantity: Add to Bag MXR® 15 FT STANDARD INSTRUMENT CABLE - STRAIGHT / STRAIGHT DCIS15 $20.99 Decrease Quantity: Increase Quantity: × OK About Careers Contact Site Feedback Support Store Locator Gear Support My Account Product Registration Custom Picks Legal Statement of Accessibility Copyrights & Trademarks Terms & Conditions Icon Agreement Contest Rule

sources.excerpt: RANDY RHOADS MXR® SPECIAL EDITION DISTORTION+ Home / Store / Electronics / Effects Pedals / Distortion +5 +4 +3 +2 RANDY RHOADS MXR® SPECIAL EDITION DISTORTION+ SKU RR104C $189.99 Quantity: 1 Add More Add to Bag Go to Checkout Share this product with your friends Share Share Pin it RANDY RHOADS MXR® SPECIAL EDITION DISTORTION+ Product Details Unleash the legacy. Ignite your tone.     Celebrate the unmistakable sound of Randy Rhoads—the trailblazing guitar virtuoso who defined an era with his blistering tone, classically inspired technique, and genre-defining solos. The MXR Randy Rhoads Distortion+ Special Edition captures the very heart of that sonic revolution, faithfully recreating the exact circuitry and feel of Randy’s original pedal—down to the gritty, harmonic-laden edge that helped shape his most iconic riffs with Ozzy Osbourne.   This isn’t just another distortion box. For the first time in over four decades, MXR engineers gained exclusive access to Randy’s actual pedalboard—preserved by his family at the Musonia School of Music. With the direct guidance of Randy’s sister, Kathy Rhoads, they meticulously dissected, documented, and reproduced the tonal blueprint of his vintage Distortion+, resulting in a pedal that bleeds with authenticity and fire.   Visually, this pedal pays tribute to Randy’s legendary custom Flying V, inspired by a Concorde jet and styled in white with striking pinstripes. This collector’s edition features that same elegant look, transforming your pedalboard into a shrine to high-octane guitar artistry. It even includes an exclusive booklet curated by the Rhoads family—offering a rare glimpse into Randy’s legacy.   From searing lead tones to punchy, saturated rhythms, the Randy Rhoads Distortion+ is the missing link between your rig and rock immortality. Whether you’re chasing the epic leads of “Crazy Train” or forging your own path with vintage fury, this pedal delivers raw, expressive, amp-pushing distortion that defined a generation. Specs   Pedal Type: Distortion Controls: Output, Distortion Bypass Switching: True Bypass Power: 9V battery or 9V DC power supply (not included) Special Features: Faithful recreation of Randy Rhoads’ original Distortion+ pedal Finish: White with custom black pinstripe—styled after Randy’s iconic Flying V Limited Edition Inclusions: Collector’s booklet with exclusive Randy Rhoads photos and history Enclosure: Road-ready metal housing with vintage-style aesthetics   Dial into the distortion that helped shape metal’s golden age—now reborn with precision and soul.   “We are very proud of, and honored by, this special signature pedal. Top friday Cool Member Posts: 105 Joined: Sun Oct 12, 2014 8:38 pm Re: MXR® Randy Rhoads Special Edition Distortion+ Quote Post by friday » Thu Aug 22, 2024 8:35 pm 3 days ago, US$170 https://guitarbomb.com/2024/08/02/mxr-r ... is-coming/ Top Cryptic Night Mass Poster Posts: 632 Joined: Sun Sep 09, 2007 7:39 am Location: My House Re: MXR® Randy Rhoads Special Edition Distortion+ Quote Post by Cryptic Night » Fri Aug 23, 2024 3:35 am I've been seeing a lot of talk about it, but I've not seen anywhere about what actually makes this different than a regular Distortion+ ? I get that the modern standard one uses silicon, I think, and the old ones used germanium, but like 10 years ago they had released a vintage script version (that I own) and so far besides the paint job, I'm not seeing anything different about this. Like the lunar and solar lights, humanity's unaligned, undefined. I get that the modern standard one uses silicon, I think, and the old ones used germanium, but like 10 years ago they had released a vintage script version (that I own) and so far besides the paint job, I'm not seeing anything different about this. I have that "true" script reissue you are talking about and it does sound much better than all the block logo versions, and other reissues previously released. I still have it but haven't played it in a few years. My initial thoughts are the Randy version does sound better on that video above, maybe all placebo Wish I knew it was a limited run, I went to buy one the next day and it was out of stock everywhere already.
